article_title: AI is less regulated than milk, Microsoft president says

tasks.prompt: What is the main argument Brad Smith makes in the article?
options: AI companies should stop all product development immediately.
Only Microsoft should be allowed to test advanced AI.
AI needs enforceable global safety rules because voluntary company promises are not sufficient.
The United States should copy every existing EU technology law.
tasks.correct_answer: AI needs enforceable global safety rules because voluntary company promises are not sufficient.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סמית טוען שנדרשים כללי בטיחות גלובליים ומחייבים, משום שפיקוח עצמי והצהרות מרצון אינם מספיקים מול חברות פחות אחראיות.

tasks.prompt: Which requirement did Smith propose for an AI-related incident?
options: Firms should write incident reports and notify victims if an AI system goes rogue.
Every AI product should be manufactured in the UK.
Consumers should inspect AI systems without expert help.
Companies should delete all models involved in minor errors.
tasks.correct_answer: Firms should write incident reports and notify victims if an AI system goes rogue.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סמית הציע חובה חוקית להכין דוחות אירוע ולהודיע לנפגעים אם מערכת AI יוצאת משליטה או גורמת לפריצה.

tasks.prompt: What does “vet new AI technology” mean in this context?
options: Sell the technology to hospitals
Describe it in an advertisement
Examine and evaluate it carefully before release
Allow it to regulate itself
tasks.correct_answer: Examine and evaluate it carefully before release
tasks.explanation_hebrew: vet פירושו לבדוק ולהעריך בקפידה; סמית מציע שמעריכים ממשלתיים עצמאיים יבחנו טכנולוגיות חדשות לפני השקה.

tasks.prompt: Why does Smith believe the UK could lead global AI rule-making?
options: It has banned all foreign AI firms.
It owns the largest AI company in the world.
Its laws already regulate AI more strictly than milk.
It has strong technical capability through the AI Security Institute and may be more acceptable to Washington than the EU.
tasks.correct_answer: It has strong technical capability through the AI Security Institute and may be more acceptable to Washington than the EU.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סמית מצביע על היכולת הטכנית של מכון אבטחת ה־AI הבריטי ועל יחס חיובי יותר של וושינגטון לבריטניה לעומת בריסל.

tasks.prompt: Why does Smith compare AI regulation with rules for milk and washing machines?
options: To show that familiar products receive routine safety oversight while powerful AI has fewer formal safeguards
To argue that AI should be sold in supermarkets
To claim that washing machines are more dangerous than AI
To suggest food inspectors should design AI models
tasks.correct_answer: To show that familiar products receive routine safety oversight while powerful AI has fewer formal safeguards
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההשוואה מדגישה את הפער: מוצרים יומיומיים כפופים לכללי בטיחות ובדיקות, בעוד שטכנולוגיית AI חזקה עדיין אינה מפוקחת באותה מידה.

tasks.prompt: What is an AI “kill switch” as described in the article?
options: A programme that permanently removes the internet
A control that can pause or slow an AI system if it gets out of control
A rule preventing independent evaluation
A tool for increasing a model's speed
tasks.correct_answer: A control that can pause or slow an AI system if it gets out of control
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה ש־kill switch הוא מעין בלם חירום שמאפשר לעצור או להאט מערכת AI אם היא יוצאת משליטה.

tasks.prompt: What did US technology executives agree to in the document signed at the White House?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין עבודה עם מבקרים עצמאיים, בדיקה שהמערכות פועלות כמתוכנן ומניעת חדירה או גישה בלתי מכוונת למערכות טכניות.
expected_points: The companies agreed to work with independent auditors.
Auditors would assess whether AI systems operate as intended.
The companies would seek to ensure the systems do not hack or access technical systems in unintended ways.
The agreement was described as morally binding rather than a complete legal regime.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Smith's proposed approach to making advanced AI safer.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול כללים גלובליים מחייבים, הערכה חיצונית, בלמי חירום, דיווח על אירועים והודעה לנפגעים, וכן את תפקיד בריטניה.
expected_points: Create global, enforceable safety rules rather than relying only on self-regulation.
Require independent evaluators to examine some AI products before release.
Give firms emergency brakes and require incident reports and victim notification.
Use the UK's technical expertise and diplomatic position to help bring countries and companies together.

tasks.prompt: Why does Smith say self-regulation may protect the public only partly?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שחברות אחראיות עשויות לציית מרצון, אך חברות פחות אחראיות אינן מחויבות לכך; לכן דרושים כללים ואכיפה אחידים.
expected_points: Responsible companies may follow voluntary standards.
Less responsible firms may choose not to make the same safety commitments.
Risks can affect victims and cyber-security beyond a single company.
Binding rules and external checks would apply more consistently across the sector.

tasks.prompt: Write a brief neutral policy note presenting both Smith's and Trump's positions on AI regulation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג ללא הטיה את דרישת סמית לכללים מחייבים ואת העדפת טראמפ לפיקוח עצמי כדי לשמור על תחרותיות מול סין.
expected_points: Explain that Smith views AI as both a useful tool and a possible weapon requiring urgent safeguards.
List at least two safeguards he proposes, such as external evaluation, incident reporting or emergency brakes.
State that Trump favours industry self-regulation.
Explain that Trump's stated concern is preventing US firms from losing ground to Chinese competitors.
